execution.raw_text:
1. Objective: Retrieve all IC50 activity records for the parent compound CHEMBL3716726 and all of its salt/derivative forms against target CHEMBL375. Return full provenance including compound identifiers, structures, assay details, literature references, and target metadata.

2. Output: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism

3. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs

4. Logic: Identify the parent compound by filtering molecule_dictionary where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3716726'. Retrieve all related forms by joining molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno = parent.molregno and joining back to molecule_dictionary as child on child.molregno = hierarchy.molregno. Include the parent row in the result set. Join compound_structures on child.molregno to obtain canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on child.molregno to link to activities via record_id. Filter activities where standard_type = 'IC50'. Join assays on assay_id and filter where tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL375'). Join docs on doc_id to obtain pubmed_id and doi. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid to retrieve target metadata. Construct pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id over doi. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
